name: @kanban/shared
description: Validation schemas and DTO types shared by the client and the server
comment: Bundlers get the TypeScript sources and the CommonJS server gets dist.
Rollup cannot statically read named exports out of tsc's CommonJS output
(export * becomes __exportStar(require(...))), so pointing Vite at dist
breaks the production build even though tsc and Vitest are happy.
